question: What is the purpose of the class token in ViT?
direct_answer: It provides a learned global token that can aggregate information from all patch tokens for prediction.
expanded_answer: The class token is prepended to the token sequence and updated through the transformer layers. Because it attends to the patch tokens, it can collect image-wide information and serve as a compact representation for classification or other downstream tasks.
common_wrong_ideas: The class token is the same as a label token
Only patch tokens are trained and the class token is fixed
